source.title: [已压缩 20260804T210000] 技能即时处理与自动提取

content: The `hermes-session-compactor` skill is installed at `/var/home/charlie/.hermes/skills/hermes-session-compactor` with a semi-automatic timer (`hermes-session-compactor.timer`) enabled to run every 30 minutes. New compressed sessions follow the naming pattern `[已压缩 YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS] <original_session_id>`.
